liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (5 reviews): Jack Straw is described as blazing; Phil drops heavy bass throughout Jack Straw [14][15][20][22][25]
- **Dancing In The Street** (4 reviews): Dancin' into Franklin's Tower opens the show at full intensity; Attendee says this was the last Dancin' ever played [14][15][21][23]
- **Terrapin Station** (3 reviews): Singles out Dancin' and the move from Space into Terrapin; Terrapin and The Other One emerging from Space are highlighted [19][20][23]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Franklin's is well played but abrupt, lacking dynamic build [21]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Peggy-O has a comforting, strolling feel [21]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The Terrapin into Other One sequence is praised [25]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Stella Blue is called great [23]
- **Black Muddy River** (1 other source): Black Muddy River was the encore [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-04-06.140339.sbd.miller.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 147 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd87-04-06.sbd-matrix.hinko.19848.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 138 min; rated 3.83/5 by 30 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hears a deep, rich, up-front recording with balanced levels that captures crowd energy; Reviewer says the matrix is a big improvement over the audience tape; Clear for an audience-style recording, though with a typical Meadowlands room sound [14][15][19]
- **gd87-04-06.schoeps.eD.10924.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 139 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [8]
- **gd1987-04-06.140376.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 20 songs; 147 min [2]

## Around the show

- Attendee found the Meadowlands a poor venue, spoiling the evening despite a strong setlist [17]
- Attendee says Jerry played dynamically, relearning guitar after a coma within the prior year [24]
- Says the previous night is probably the best of the tour [22]
- Notes the unusual setlist against the many stock setlists of 1987 [22]
- Attendee felt the show lacked jamming, though the tour was great with Jerry sober [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-04-06.140339.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [1]. Also: Two sets of masters were combined to make the show complete [1]
- **gd87-04-06.sbd-matrix.hinko.19848.sbeok.shnf**: source: Healy Matrix TDK MA-90 cassette > Dick's Reel (Technics 1506) > PCM > CD (HHB CDR 800) > EAC > SHN [6]. Also: Recording was posted by Jonathan Aizen [19]
- **gd87-04-06.schoeps.eD.10924.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>MC>DAT>CDRSchoeps CMC-441Âs>Sony D-5 [8]. Also: Reviewer's download came from a different, now-removed source than this audience recording [20]
- **gd1987-04-06.140376.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1987-04-06 Meadowlands Arena, East Rutherford, NJ, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-04-06-meadowlands-arena-east-rutherford-nj-usa/) [27]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Meadowlands Arena - April 7, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/april-7-1987) [28]
